claims.excerpt: used different mechanisms to regulate sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from the power sector
claims.claim: The program regulated sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from the power sector using different mechanisms.
claims.label: F0
claims.evidence: EPA’s Acid Rain Program addresses sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from the power sector under Title IV. The sulfur dioxide mechanism applies an aggregate cap and allows trading; one allowance covers one ton. ... The nitrogen oxides component was rate-based for certain coal-fired units, began in 1996 and did not introduce a cap or allowance trading.
claims.narrative: The Acid Rain Program addressed sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from the power sector, but it did not use one shared emissions mechanism.
claims.explanation: The source describes distinct sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides mechanisms.
claims.materiality: High: this is the piece’s central comparison.
